results.title: Learn about illicit financial flows in Benin and Cabo Verde
results.prose: Dr. Lyla Latif — with House of Fiscal Wisdom — walks newsrooms through trade misinvoicing and extractive contracts that bleed sovereign revenue. The briefing sits beside the Red Flags monograph partners can cite the same week.

results.title: Digital PF Reform Stories Country-experiences - South Africa, Ghana, Namibia, Kenya, Rwanda, Malawi
results.prose: Co-produced with CABRI: ministries of finance across Anglophone Africa compare digital PFM breakthroughs — IFMIS, e-procurement, and peer learning partners can brief against without inventing a single allocation figure.

results.title: Project Terra
results.prose: Project TERRA — Technology, Equality, Regulatory Risk Assessment — with House of Fiscal Wisdom and Luminate. The film opens how platform architectures and tax concessions make African women workers invisible in public revenue systems.
